blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Wednesday said President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is inclined to support a proposal to suspend real property tax hikes amid private-sector concerns that higher valuations could increase property owners’ financial burden. Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said the Department of Finance (DOF) had already begun taking action on the issue following Marcos’ meeting with members of the Private Sector Advisory Council (PSAC) Infrastructure Sector Group – Real Estate in Malacañang on Tuesday. The private companies sought the suspension of increases in real property values to prevent higher taxes from being passed on to property owners, Castro said. […]...
